verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented setting or policy that lets users opt out of having their Sentry data used to train AI models. The controls shown (`include_prompts=False`, prompt capture off by default, `recordInputs`/`recordOutputs`) only govern whether an app's LLM prompts are collected into Sentry. They are adjacent data-collection controls, not AI-training opt-outs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
